issues.description: Field mismatch for Farm.animals: the UML in problem_statement.md declares animals as a private attribute (UML shows "- animals: List<Animal>") indicating encapsulation via getter/setter, while the solution implementation declares the field as public (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java: line 9: "public List<Animal> animals;"). This discrepancy can confuse students about intended encapsulation and whether they should access the list directly or via the provided getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in the solution to match the UML and the exercise instructions (change to: private List<Animal> animals;), and continue to expose it via the existing getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods. Alternatively, if public exposure was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to show the field as public and clarify that direct access is allowed.
